preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(line.strip()) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case integer n must satisfy 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5.
The number of test cases T must satisfy 1 ≤ T ≤ 10.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == n for output_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: Each output line must contain exactly n space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(num) <= n for num in output_line.split()) for output_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: Each output integer must be in the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(output_line.split())) == n for output_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: Each output line must contain n distinct integers (permutation).

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(num) != i+1 for i, num in enumerate(output_line.split())) for output_line, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: For each output permutation, no element at index i (1-based) equals i+1 (1-based).

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(output_line.split()[i]) < int(q.split()[i]) for i in range(n) if int(output_line.split()[i]) != int(q.split()[i])) for output_line, q, n in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [next_permutation(n) for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]], [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: Each output permutation is lexicographically smaller than any other valid good permutation of the same length n, where next_permutation(n) is the next lexicographically larger good permutation (if it exists).
